title: Char Count
summary: Count how often each character occurs in text. A character here is one Unicode code point: "ë" is one character and so is an emoji, however many bytes they take.
hints: Find out what your language's string loop gives you: bytes, UTF-16 code units or code points. Only code points are right here.
Every track has a way to walk a string by code point: a for-of loop, iterating the string, .chars(), range over a string, utf8.codes, or splitting with a Unicode-aware pattern.
Use each code point (as a string) as the map key and add one to its count.

cases.description: an accented letter is one character
a combining accent counts on its own
